```python
import os
from hamana.connector.db import Oracle

# Read credentials from environment variables
user = os.environ["ORACLE_USER"]
password = os.environ["ORACLE_PASSWORD"]
host = os.environ["ORACLE_HOST"]
service = os.environ["ORACLE_SERVICE"]

# Build configuration object
config = Oracle.create_config(
    user=user,
    password=password,
    host=host,
    service=service
)

# Construct connector from configuration
connector = Oracle(config)

# Execute query
query_result = connector.execute("SELECT sysdate FROM dual")

# Print results
print(query_result.result)
```
